Q192.reason: The friend only feigned agreement and lacked genuine intent to further the crime, so no conspiracy or other offense.

Q193.reason: Under Plyler v. Doe, excluding undocumented children from school via a fee is invalid because it does not substantially further a substantial state interest.

Q194.reason: Under the perfect tender rule, delivering 490 of 500 widgets is a failure to perform the contract as written, so the buyer can recover.
